name: abu-app-finance-reconciliation
description: 财务对账：对账、分析、报表，由财务对账专家团负责

interface.longDescription: 给财务同事准备的应用：对账、分析和报表三组场景，由随阿布附带的财务对账专家团负责——财务助理带队，数据分析师算数，办公文档专家出报表。
capabilities: 读取你上传的流水、费用表和报销单
生成对账结果、差异说明和费用报表

app.promptAppend: The user does finance reconciliation. Work from the files they upload, show every difference you find with its source rows, and never invent a number that is not in the data.

slogan.zh-CN: 把流水和费用表交给我，差异我来找
slogan.en-US: Hand me the statements and the expense sheet; I will find the differences

placeholder.zh-CN: 上传流水和费用表，说明对账口径
placeholder.en-US: Upload the statement and the expense sheet, state the rules

prompt.zh-CN: 把这份流水和费用表对一遍，列出对不上的条目和原因
prompt.en-US: Match this statement against the expense sheet and list every unmatched item with a reason

prompt.zh-CN: 按季度汇总这些费用并和流水核对，给出差异清单
prompt.en-US: Aggregate these expenses by quarter, check them against the statement and give the difference list

prompt.zh-CN: 检查这批费用里有没有重复记账或重复报销
prompt.en-US: Check these expenses for duplicate entries or duplicate claims

prompt.zh-CN: 整理这批报销单，按标准标出超标的项目
prompt.en-US: Tidy these expense claims and flag the items over the limit

prompt.zh-CN: 列出缺少票据或票据信息不全的报销条目
prompt.en-US: List the claims with missing or incomplete receipts

prompt.zh-CN: 把这批报销按人和类别汇总成一张表
prompt.en-US: Summarize these claims by person and category in one table

prompt.zh-CN: 分析这两个月费用变化的原因，按类别说明
prompt.en-US: Explain the change in costs between these two months, by category

prompt.zh-CN: 把实际费用和预算对比，指出超支的地方
prompt.en-US: Compare actual costs with the budget and point out the overruns

prompt.zh-CN: 给出近半年各类费用的趋势和一句判断
prompt.en-US: Show the six-month trend per category with a one-line reading

prompt.zh-CN: 根据这些数据出一份月度费用报表，附一段说明
prompt.en-US: Produce a monthly expense report from this data, with a short note

prompt.zh-CN: 把这份报表压缩成一页汇报摘要
prompt.en-US: Condense this report into a one-page summary for the meeting

prompt.zh-CN: 把这份报表整理成下个月能直接复用的模板
prompt.en-US: Turn this report into a template reusable next month
